name: mpss
description: A multi-platform C++ library for hardware-backed digital signature key storage and signing.

openssl.description: Build the OpenSSL 3.x provider (mpss-openssl), including key-reference serialization.

serialization.description: Enable C++ key-reference DER and PEM serialization without requiring the provider.

yubikey.description: Enable the YubiKey PIV backend. Required on Linux (no OS-native backend available).
